corrected.quote: The objectives of this investigation were to: (1) determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity and (2) investigate the low-g flammability limits compared to those obtained in NASA’s normal gravity material flammability screening test.
corrected.derivation: Objective statement, not a statement of the test condition. The JSON field has line breaks after 'to:' and after 'normal', each joined with one space. Source term 'low-gravity'; no g-level stated; mapped to the controlled term microgravity. The same objective wording is in the Objectives PDF abstract (page 1), which covers Saffire-I, -II and -III; page 3 assigns objective (2) to Saffire-II.
